what: EL-B05: first run of the webhook profile (tools/event-loop-audit/load/run-load.mjs --profiles=webhook --seconds=40 --contacts=500 --settle-seconds=15): the normal 5 req/s mix with 30 % of requests replaced by unauthenticated WhatsApp deliveries of a 256 KB body carrying a bad signature (the refused path, EL-B22).
limits: One 44 s run on a Windows laptop with Docker Desktop, 500 contacts, ~60 webhook requests. Indicative, not a baseline: no second run to compare, no dedicated host. The webhook share (30 %) and body size (256 KB, Meta batches are far smaller) are chosen, not observed.
